faces.name: Ureni of the Unwritten
faces.oracleText:
Flying, trample
Whenever Ureni enters or attacks, look at the top eight cards of your library. You may put a Dragon creature card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

faces.name: Ureni's Counsel
Ureni's Rebuff
faces.oracleText:
Return target creature to its owner's hand.
Harmonize {5}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its harmonize cost. You may tap a creature you control to reduce that cost by {X}, where X is its power. Then exile this spell.)

faces.name: Ureni, the Song Unending
faces.oracleText:
Flying, protection from white and from black
When Ureni enters, it deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers your opponents control, where X is the number of lands you control.

faces.name: Ureni's Lair
faces.oracleText:
Whenever one or more creatures you control enter during your turn, put a flying counter on one of them. It becomes a Spirit Dragon with base power and toughness 5/5 in addition to its other types. This ability triggers only once each turn.
Whenever chaos ensues, Dragons you control gain menace and haste until end of turn.
